subject.title: [Feature]: Anthropic is still defualt in docs/start/openclaw.md example

question: Should maintainers retire the stale cross-repo linked PR path and queue a fresh target-repo docs fix, or adopt/refresh that branch instead?
rationale: The issue is valid and small, but an open cross-repo PR still claims the fix while the same-repo PRs are closed unmerged; automation should not create another duplicate until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Retire and replace
options.body: Close or ignore the stale cross-repo PR path and queue a fresh docs-only target-repo fix across the current snippets.

options.title: Adopt the linked branch
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor refresh the linked work against current main while preserving the current config shape and updating sibling provider pages.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the open cross-repo PR even though it is not a landed OpenClaw fix.

recommendation.title: Retire and replace
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the stale cross-repo PR path and queue a fresh docs-only target-repo fix across the current snippets.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the current blamed docs snippets and is the clearest source-history owner for the affected files.
